entities.name: Aquino de Bragança
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomaz Aquino Messias de Bragança was a Mozambican physicist, journalist, diplomat and social scientist at the Eduardo Mondlane University. He played a leading intellectual and political role in the campaign for the decolonialisation of Mozambique from its colonial power.
